faq_heading: Queensborough condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Queensborough. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Queensborough, New Westminster: 72 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 3 of 14 New Westminster communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Queensborough fell from 81 in June to 72 in September (−11.1%), and 41 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 16.2% of New Westminster’s 444 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Queensborough?
Queensborough also had 41 houses listed and 1 sold in September, against 72 condos and townhomes listed. The Queensborough houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Queensborough home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

53 condos sold in Queensborough with a median price of $690,000 (the middle half sold between $629,900 and $800,000), taking a median of 33 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $655 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $596 a month. 31 townhomes sold in Queensborough with a median price of $855,000 (the middle half sold between $790,000 and $916,500), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $589 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median strata fee of $437 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Queensborough?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 72 condos and townhomes listed in Queensborough. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Queensborough a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Queensborough had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Queensborough from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 41 condos and townhomes sold in Queensborough over those 4 months, out of 261 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Queensborough sell for?
faq.a: 53 condos sold in Queensborough between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $690,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Queensborough?
faq.a: The median was 33 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.7% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
